280806824.description:
Crystal and Fossil Specimen Collection
Mixed Geological and Paleontological Lot
Natural Materials, 10.6 lbs Total Weight
An extensive and diverse collection of geological specimens and prehistoric fossils, offering a wide array of educational and decorative pieces. This lot features a balanced mix of raw crystalline formations, professionally identified fossils, and polished mineral specimens, making it an excellent starter set for a new collector or a significant addition to an existing display.
Fossil Cave Bear Molar (Ursus spelaeus) from the Pleistocene era, found in Romania
Large Amethyst geode and Quartz crystal geode specimens
Two Trilobite fossils preserved in rocky matrix and one Osteichthyes (Bony Fish) fossil
Fossilized Coprolite (Dinosaur Poop) and a collection of small shark teeth in a display case
Large assortment of tumbled polished stones including rose quartz, tiger's eye, and carnelian
Significant quantity of Pyrite (Fool's Gold) clusters and various raw mineral specimens
Condition:
The collection is in good condition as natural specimens. The Cave Bear Molar is well-preserved with an intact identification card. Geodes show sharp crystalline structures with typical exterior matrix wear. Fossils exhibit clear details relative to their species. Tumbled stones are highly polished with minimal surface bruising. Coprolite is contained in protective packaging. Pyrite clusters show characteristic metallic luster.

281485184.description: This listing is for a natural stibnite (stibnite, also known as antimony) raw mineral specimen. The specimen features metallic gray, elongated bladed crystals radiating in a fan-like cluster with a bright silver sheen and some darker tarnished areas. Small whitish and grayish matrix or secondary mineral deposits are visible among the crystals. It measures approximately 2.5 x 2 x 1.75 inches and weighs about 95.4 grams as shown on a digital scale. Please note that stibnite is a naturally brittle and delicate material, so some flaking or shedding of crystals is possible. Suitable for geological and mineral collectors.

Natural Geode Specimens
Set of Two Quartz Crystal Formations
Natural Mineral Specimen

The larger, more rounded piece showcases a deep cavity lined with translucent to opaque white crystals, while the second piece displays a more open, heart-shaped configuration. Both specimens retain their natural, rough exterior matrix, providing a striking contrast between the rugged outer shell and the delicate crystalline interior.
Rounder geode measures approximately 6.25" x 4.25" x 4"
Authentic mineral specimens with natural crystalline sparkle and textural variety
Ideal for geological study, home decor display, or as a natural history collectible
Total combined weight of 5.14 lbs as measured on a digital scale
